snippet.title: Eldritch Climb: A Cursed Ascent | Trailer
snippet.description:
Get to the heart of a devious mountain in this climbing game with roguelike elements and a cosmic horror style. Loot eclectic items, and swing and launch yourself through ever-changing levels while obtaining Eyes... The more you have, the harder the climb and the creepier the vibe! 

Wishlist now on Steam and Check our Demo!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2645670/Eldritch_Climb_A_Cursed_Ascent/
